(() => { const d=document.getElementById('optional_details'); const g=d.closest('.form-group')||d.parentElement; return {optionalDetailsDisplay:getComputedStyle(d).display, parentTag:d.parentElement.tagName, parentClass:d.parentElement.className, siblings:[...d.parentElement.children].map(c=>c.tagName+'#'+c.id+'.'+c.className)}; })()
